title: SOCES
subtitle: Washington, D.C. January 3-7, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for SOCES. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C.

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & United States Holocaust Memorial Museum

  • Welcome to Washington, D.C.!
  • Group sit-down breakfast
  • Visit the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (three nights)
 

Day 3: United States Capitol Building & National Archives Museum

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit 
  • Professional Group Photo on the US Capitol Steps
  • Visit the United States Capitol Building 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture 
  • Visit the National Archives Museum
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: The People’s House & Tidal Basin Memorials Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial 
  • Visit The People’s House
  • Group Exploration of the Smithsonian Museums 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 5: Steven F. Udvar-Hazy Center & Depart for Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Steven F. Udvar-Hazy Center 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: SOCES, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From powerful memorials and historic landmarks to inspiring museums and government buildings, this Washington, D.C. experience brings American history to life at every turn. Students will explore Arlington National Cemetery, stand on the steps of the U.S. Capitol, and visit moving sites like the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum and National Museum of African American History and Culture. They’ll also discover the stories behind our nation at the National Archives, Smithsonian museums, and the memorials surrounding the National Mall and Tidal Basin. It’s the perfect blend of history, learning, and unforgettable moments—an experience your students will never forget!
